description.value: Structural MRI studies of brain morphology and tissue abnormalities in children and adults with prenatal alcohol exposure, including FAS and FASD, compared with controls.
The report summarizes quantitative structural MRI studies comparing prenatal alcohol-exposed individuals with controls.
